planets.name: K2-136 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-136 with a 7.98-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: K2-136 b was found in 2017 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-136. Its orbit and size follow Mayo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
